source: Ed4 K.2.3, p.K-5; K.3.2.3, Table 3, pp.K-9 to K-10
description: In LBT_WAIT each busy period holds LBT_WAIT_TIMER; when the channel is idle again it restarts with lbt_wait_dcd_ms, since neither burst gave an EOT, so each idle is DCD-determined; it expires that long after the last busy indication clears.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). The S_UNIDATA_REQUEST is priority 0 to SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0, U_PDU "hello"; it asks for no confirmation, so it produces no SIS output (A-0095), and it is data queued for transmission (K-0096). Hold while busy is cancel at the busy indication and start at the idle one (K-0087; core-architecture.md 3.3). The value on each idle follows the LBT rules (K-0120): no EOT was parsed from either burst, so DCD produced the idle and rule 2 gives lbt_wait_dcd_ms; csma-held-lbt-two-node-zero-wait and csma-held-lbt-vdcd-value show rules 1 and 3 after a hold. The first contention draw of seed 0 is uniform(16) = 15, so 45000 ms (prng.md 5). Since corpus 0.7.0 the DTS also keeps dts.ttd at the earliest TTD in its transmit queue: started when a request becomes the earliest, cancelled when the transmit queue empties (C-1050).
